During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''individual''' collected [[Chess/Legends|chess]] pieces crafted from the tusks of the dangerous [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]], though her sculptor ran out of raw materials when the collector needed one more piece to complete her set.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Pawns of the Dark Side}}</ref>
